> I've replaced the text with sensitive info in URLS
Interesting twist. URLs clearly contain a thing called path, but I doubt that is what "less secure access paths" was referring to.  

The first part of the original rule about not having alternative access paths should go for sure. It's ok to offer multiple alternative APIs from a security standpoint as long as they're all secured in the same way/to the same level.

That last part is important, though, I think.  And in my eyes it'd be worth having a security rule for that.
Just make it more clear what is actually meant here.

Maybe like this?
"Verify that there are no less secure ways to get the same access (to the service)"
